name: Mushroom Moon Math
rules_text:
There are 9 red mushrooms and 6 blue mushrooms. How many mushrooms?
Make 10 if useful: 9 needs 1 to reach 10; then add the remaining 5. Write 9 + 6 = 15.
Answer: 15
